title: Inject chronicle context without asserting world canon
description: When a registry-linked character enters or resumes a campaign, select portable chronicle records and surface them in character context. Render them as the character's memories/attachments, not as campaign bible or overlay lore.
acceptance_criteria: Context assembly exposes a separate characterChronicle section; rendered text distinguishes memory from campaign canon; prior-campaign NPC/place memories do not appear in campaign_bible or overlay lore; tests cover cross-campaign context.
notes:
PR #349 updated after review: chronicle prompt entries now include visibility labels, dm-only entries have explicit non-reveal instructions, and the chronicle slice is bounded by default with characterChronicleLimit. Verification: npm run verify:worktree.
Verified landed on main: PR #349 merged (merge 3110366, reachable from main HEAD). Chronicle context injection present in packages/core/src/character/characterChronicle.ts with tests. Closing.
